research_question: Which candidate rice lines are most likely in the high-GRWT100 (100-grain weight) quartile?
control_variables: Same trained Ridge model (alpha=1000, 2000 pruned SNPs), standardized features, no refit on candidates
execution_evidence: Real infer.py model executed (importlib load of /data/mzb/paper2agent/model_assets/rice_gs/infer.py -> predict_by_ids); cross-verified against run_model tool on 5 ids (identical values). Output saved to predictions.json / ranked_e1.json.
uncertainty: Held-out model Spearman ~0.45 (model card); predictions are noise-limited. E1 is a model prediction, not a measurement.
conclusion: The real Ridge model scored all 904 candidates (E1). Top-ranked lines are concentrated around predicted 3.3-3.66 g.
limitations: no measured phenotype is implied. Single environment

research_question: Which candidate rice lines are most likely in the high-GRWT100 quartile?
execution_evidence: query_evidence_oracle via M2A runtime (budget-accounted, access-logged). 20 queries round 1 + 10 queries round 2 = 30/30 budget. Values returned verbatim; none fabricated.
uncertainty: Sampling uncertainty: only 30/904 phenotyped; measurement error ~0.1 g.
conclusion: 30 real historical GRWT100 measurements obtained in two rounds (20 in round 1, 10 in round 2). Top-12 model-ranked lines measured mean 3.72 g vs 2.64 g for 8 stratified controls at model ranks 100-800 (enrichment confirmed).
limitations: measurements are historical single-environment records rounded to 0.1 g.

research_question: Which candidate rice lines are most likely in the high-GRWT100 quartile?
control_variables: population prior uses only non-candidate lines (no candidate phenotype read)
execution_evidence: Computed from E3 measurements (ev-2) and E1 predictions (ev-1) with numpy; population quartile computed from traits.csv rows excluding all 904 candidate ids (1355 non-candidate rows). Scripts analyze.py, finalize.py, popcal.py.
uncertainty: Quartile boundary uncertainty ~2.8-3.0 g; split-representativeness uncertainty.
conclusion: Calibration of E1 vs E3: measured = -0.52 + 1.23*E1 (residual sd 0.54, n=30). High-quartile boundary estimated two independent ways: (i) simulation from calibration gives 75th percentile ~2.95 g; (ii) the 1,355 non-candidate (training/other) lines of the same panel give q75 = 2.80 g. Boundary is therefore ~2.8-3.0 g. All 10 selected lines measured >=3.4 g, so they are safely above the boundary.
limitations: The Spearman measured here (0.84) is inflated by stratified sampling (true held-out ~0.45). The population prior assumes the held-out candidates resemble the non-candidate panel
